title: Ransomware hits healthcare - Clearing of system logs
description: // Look for attempts to use fsutil.exe to delete file system logs that can be used as forensic artifacts.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Process Name' = 'fsutil.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*usn*' and 'Command Line' like '*deletejournal*')
